subject: NovaPlatform — Redwood onboarding & SDK plan
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>, Alex Dorsey <alex.dorsey@novaplat.com>, Maria Gonzalez <m.gonzalez@novaplat.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 15:12:00 +0000
Subject: NovaPlatform — Redwood onboarding & SDK plan

Hi team —

Quick handoff: NovaPlatform (Alex / Maria) signed yesterday and are ready to start implementation next week. High-level asks from their first call: SDK setup & sample code, guidance for endpoint migration (they currently call our legacy /v1/generate path), retry and timeout recommendations, and explicit guidance on rate limit handling for bursty traffic from mobile clients.

Attaching a draft mutual action plan (NovaPlatform-MAP-v1.xlsx) — my asks:
- Lauren, can you be CS lead and run the kickoff?
- Grace, please own the technical onboarding (SDK examples, migration doc, retries/timeouts).
- Stephanie, can you prepare the paperwork and DocuSign SOW flow? We have a HubSpot deal RDW-54321.

Proposed kickoff: Wed, Jun 24 between 16:00-17:00 PT (we can adjust).

Next steps I’ll own: share quickstart PDF and a short checklist for the first two sprints.

Thanks —
Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

Attachments: NovaPlatform-MAP-v1.xlsx

On Mon, Jun 22, 2026 at 15:12, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Quick handoff: NovaPlatform (Alex / Maria) signed yesterday and are ready to start implementation next week.

Thanks Karthik — happy to take this.

Confirming I’ll run the kickoff and own customer success for the initial 90-day onboarding. I’ll cover: kickoff agenda, success metrics (latency & cost targets), integration milestones, and escalation paths. I uploaded a short SDK quickstart we typically share: redwood-sdk-quickstart.pdf (attached).

Kickoff proposal: Wed, Jun 24 16:00 PT. Agenda (30–45 min):
- Intros & roles (5 min)
- High-level plan & milestones (10 min)
- SDK quickstart walk-through (10 min)
- Endpoint migration plan & blockers (10 min)
- Q&A / next steps (remaining)

Call invite: I’ll send calendar once Alex/Maria confirm. I’ll also add the shared Drive folder with onboarding docs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-novaplat-onboarding

Lauren
Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood-sdk-quickstart.pdf

From: Maria Gonzalez <m.gonzalez@novaplat.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Dorsey <alex.dorsey@novaplat.com>, ops-team@novaplat.com
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 18:20:00 +0000
Subject: Re: NovaPlatform — Redwood onboarding & SDK plan

Thanks — this looks great. Wed, Jun 24 16:00 PT works for us (I’ll accept the invite from Lauren). Two quick questions before kickoff:

1) Rate limits: our mobile app can produce short bursts from thousands of clients after a marketing push. Can you confirm the per-key RPS / minute and whether you support per-subnet or per-application quotas? We’d like to avoid head-of-line blocking.

2) Token accounting: do you provide a token-level breakdown per request in the response / logs so we can reason about cost per feature?

3) Security: we are SOC2-aligned and need to confirm how audit logs for API requests are surfaced. I know there’s a questionnaire in HubSpot — we’ll attach our security checklist to the Drive folder.

Also, Stephanie — can you send the SOW via DocuSign? We want to get the paperwork signed before the kickoff so that we can enable the Dedicated capacity bump if needed. HubSpot deal RDW-54321 should have the pricing terms.

Best,
Maria
VP Product, NovaPlatform

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Maria Gonzalez <m.gonzalez@novaplat.com>, Alex Dorsey <alex.dorsey@novaplat.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 09:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: NovaPlatform — Redwood onboarding & SDK plan

Perfect — thanks for the quick replies. Short answers before the call:

- Rate limits: default hosted quota is 120 reqs/min per key; we can add per-key burst protection and per-application quotas for Dedicated customers. At kickoff we’ll capture expected QPS and traffic shape and open a request to Provisioning to pre-warm dedicated pools if you sign the SOW.
- Token accounting: yes — we include per-request token counts in the response metadata and you’ll get token-level analytics in the Console. We’ll show examples during the SDK walk-through.
- Audit logs: we expose request-level audit logs for Dedicated and Private deployments; for hosted customers we provide aggregated audit trails and can produce request logs on-demand under a support ticket.

Next steps assigned:
- Stephanie to send SOW via DocuSign today (SOW-NovaPlatform-2026.pdf).
- Lauren to send calendar invite for Wed 16:00 PT.
- Grace to attach the migration diff & demo repo link in the Drive folder ahead of the call.

Looking forward —
Karthik

Attachments: SOW-NovaPlatform-2026.pdf
